learning_objective: 🎯 We will bring drawing, music, dancing, and acting together to create the ultimate spectacular masterpiece!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Art is not just drawing! We can use a colorful mask we crafted in a stage play, or draw to the beat of our favorite dance music.
When we combine singing, dancing, acting, and drawing together, we can tell the most amazing stories and put on a grand show for our family!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Put on a Play
fun_activity.instructions: Make a paper crown and paint a cardboard box to look like a castle. Then, put on the crown and act out a fun story with your family!

quick_recap: ⭐ Art is everything beautiful: it is singing, dancing, acting, and crafting.
⭐ We can use our paper crafts as cool props to put on a theater play.
⭐ Combining all different arts together makes learning a grand adventure!
